title: Humanoid Robot Hire in Monaco | Events and Brands
desc: Hire a humanoid robot with an operator for events, launches and brand activations in Monaco and the French Riviera. Scripted, branded and walking among your guests.
lead: A humanoid robot walks into your event wearing your brand, greets your guests and poses for their photographs. We bring it, we operate it and we write the scene around your campaign. Monaco, Monte-Carlo and the whole Riviera.
heroAlt: Humanoid robot with the ROBOTMONACO wordmark on its chest, shown in 3D and turnable

why.h2: Why a robot beats another photo wall.
why.lead: Guests at a Monaco event have seen every backdrop, every champagne tower and every LED screen. They have not shaken hands with a humanoid.

items.p: People put their glass down and lift their phone. The robot creates the one moment of the evening that nobody scrolls past.
Every guest films it. You leave the night with hundreds of clips carrying your logo, filmed and posted by the people you invited.
The robot walks, waves, poses, dances and hands things over. It moves through the room instead of standing in a corner.
Opening lines, the brand message, the winner's name. In English, French or both, written with you before the day.
Your logo goes on the chest, your colours on the panels, your film on the screen behind it. The robot becomes your campaign.
An operator is always with it, steering the show and watching the crowd. You get the spectacle without the risk.

fleet.lead: The same body twice. MONTARI is set up to work the floor and the stage, NOVA is opened up so the behaviour can be written from scratch.

uses.h2: Where clients put it to work.
uses.lead: From a boutique opening on the Golden Square to a hospitality suite above the harbour during race week.

steps.p: The date, the venue, the audience and what you want people to remember. A phone call is usually enough.
You get a running order: where the robot appears, what it says, what it does and how long each moment lasts.
Your logo goes on, the script is loaded and we test the route, the floor and the lighting before doors open.
Our operator works the room with the robot, swaps the battery between blocks and packs it away when you are done.

software.h3: We also build what the robot says and does.
software.p: Beyond the hire, our engineers write custom behaviour, voice and integrations for humanoid robots, and turn a robot into an AI assistant that answers your visitors instead of reciting a loop.
software.alt: Humanoid robot walking, used for custom robot software development

faq.q: How much does it cost to hire a humanoid robot in Monaco?
faq.a: From €2,000 per day with an operator at the multi-day rate, excluding VAT. A single day, a custom script, travel and staging are quoted on top. Tell us the date and the venue and you get a firm price within 24 hours.

faq.q: Does the robot come with someone to run it?
faq.a: Always. An operator is part of every booking. The robot never performs unattended: our operator drives the show, keeps a safe distance from guests and stops it instantly if anyone gets too close.

faq.q: Can the robot carry our logo and our message?
faq.a: Yes. The wordmark on its chest is a printed decal we replace with yours, and panels can carry your colours. The spoken lines, the gestures and the running order are written around your campaign.
Monaco and Monte-Carlo are home. We regularly travel along the Riviera to Nice, Cannes, Antibes, Saint-Tropez, Menton and Villefranche-sur-Mer, and further by arrangement.

faq.q: How long can the robot perform?
faq.a: About two hours of active show on one battery. Our operator swaps batteries on site, so a full evening is a matter of planning the blocks, not of the robot running out.

faq.q: What does the robot not do?
faq.a: It does not work without an operator, does not lift heavy loads, does not walk in rain or on loose gravel, and it does not replace your staff. It is a show and a content machine, not a waiter.
